scope: Formal online correction: no automatic rollback; retain current confirmed pose and continue subsequent ICP
current_working_pose_anchor: Separate from geometrically verified pose; checked against actual scene before next candidate
retention: Read-only GET confirmation, no SET, no geometric promotion, clear pending only for known confirmed write
resampling: Preserve pose revision, clear window/history, keep cooldown and require new exposure/frame id
budgets: Initial baseline and cumulative limits preserved
exceptions: Unknown original write, external changes, stale/cancelled identity or archive failure keep automatic pose update paused; no restore command
independent_review: One read-only reviewer; archive success flag corrected before build
field_run: Not started; no camera, robot or live RobotSim loop launched
computer_use: Not used; existing authorized VS2022 Developer CLI only
